title: Session Settings
description: Controls the lifetime of the access token and refresh token issued at login. Changes apply to newly issued tokens only; existing sessions expire naturally.
accessTokenMinutesHint: 5 to 1440 minutes (up to 24 hours). Shorter is safer; longer reduces refresh traffic.
refreshTokenDaysHint: 1 to 365 days. The refresh token renews the access token silently; after expiry users must sign in again.
effectiveHint: The refresh token lifetime must be longer than the access token lifetime.
saveSuccess: Session settings saved. Newly issued tokens take effect immediately.
